messages:
mira: Hey — saw a tenant export where routing-policy changes had empty "actor" in NDJSON. probably a rollout automation that applied patch. anyone else? 
joel: Hmm, got an example id? export file? 
mira: pasted a small snippet (sanitized):
```
{ "ts": "2026-03-18T14:02:13Z", "change": "routing_policy.update", "policy_id": "rp-42", "details": {...}, "actor": null, "rollout_id": "roll-20260318-7" }
```
joel: ok looks like service-side rollout runner is setting actor=null when it does a bulk apply. it's using internal service account but we didn't map it to audit actor resolution. 
sam: from telemetry side we currently count these as "system" changes (actor_type=service) but the export pipeline strips service accounts for PII reasons. can we instead emit an opaque actor_hint so compliance can map back? 
mira: yes that's the ask — exports need enough context for "who changed what" for legal e-discovery. opaque but linkable. 
ria: We need to be careful: opaque hints must be reversible only by authorized roles. prefer adding rollout_id + actor_alias and an auth-only lookup. also quota/retention concerns for exports with lookup payloads. 
joel: proposed event shape change for NDJSON export (backwards-compatible):
```
{
  "ts":"...",
  "change":"routing_policy.update",
  "policy_id":"rp-42",
  "rollout_id":"roll-20260318-7",
  "actor_hint":"svc-operator-88",
  "actor_type":"service|user",
  "actor_resolution_mode":"none|authorized_lookup",
  "applied_by":"rollout-runner-v2"
}
```
mira: actor_resolution_mode=authorized_lookup seems right. that way export consumers can choose to hit our resolution endpoint (audit-api) with credentials. 
sam: telemetry: we'll track resolution lookups as events so we can charge/metric them. that affects export quotas — lookup-per-export could be large. recommend a default where exports include actor_hint only and console export UX offers an optional "resolve actors" toggle (which will consume lookup quota). 
joel: agree. UX in console: when you click 'Download full audit', show a small modal: [Resolve actors?] checkbox — default unchecked — tooltip: "Including resolved actor identities consumes lookup quota and may include PII." If unchecked we include actor_hint + rollout_id. 
ria: about retention for presigned links: legal wants 90 days. infra defaults to 7 days. compromise: export links for compliance roles = 90d, but flagged and audited. need RBAC hook. 
mira: rollout-runner change: ensure it writes rollout_id and applied_by fields into the change event at time of apply. assigned to @joel? 
joel: I'll do the event write + schema bump. will add migration to export generator to include actor_hint. 
sam: I'll add dashboard metric: export.resolution_lookups.count and a per-tenant cost estimate shown in modal. also add quota alert if resolution lookups > X/day. 
ria: I'll draft the compliance note and RBAC exception for extended presigned retention. will post a short policy doc. 
deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout-runner/v2 -> prod (canary 10%). 🎯
mira: perfect — thanks. quick followups: 1) joel: PR for schema + migration by end of week 2) sam: telemetry + quota UI mock by Tue 3) ria: compliance doc by Thu 
joel: on it — will ping when PR is up. 
mira: thanks all :thumbsup:
